name: obsidian-tarot-practice
description: Draw tarot and divination cards with intention-seeded randomness. Supports custom spreads, multi-deck divination systems, draw history with statistics, Handlebars templates, and full mobile support.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy-files
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
